definition: per-stabilizer fraction of n_shots where the syndrome bit = 0 (= +1 eigenvalue measured); aggregated min over all 8 stabilizers gives min_stab_plus_ratio used in verdict
expected_noiseless: all 8 stabilizers have +1 ratio = 1.0 because |0_L> is a simultaneous +1 eigenstate of every stabilizer in the Shor [[9,1,3]] CSS code, and Aer state-vector simulation is deterministic on Pauli eigenstates
raw10_caveat: stab_plus_ratios = 1.0 across all 8 syndromes is the noiseless-Aer DETERMINISTIC outcome; real hardware (depolarizing CNOT noise ~1e-3 per gate) would yield per-stabilizer +1 ratios in [0.85, 0.98] typical (X-stabs are weight-6 so suffer more CNOT noise than weight-2 Z-stabs). Toy demonstration only; no decoder applied.
